• South Coast Air Quality Management District
• UCR Career Center
• Inland Regional Energy Network (I-REN)
• UCR Engineers Without Borders
• UCR Society of Women Engineers

• RCAC
• UCR Professional and Global Education Division
• UCR Office of Sustainability

• Riverside County Office of Economic Development
